page.overview:
Who is Hirooki Goto?

Hirooki Goto is an Japanese professional wrestler who will be portraying E. Honda in the upcoming movie Street Fighter.

He is known for being a 1 time IWGP World Heavyweight Champion, 2 time IWGP Intercontinental Champion, 1 time IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Champion, 10 time IWGP Tag Team Champion, 5 time NEVER Openweight Champion, 4 time NEVER Openweight 6-Man Tag Team Champion, 1 time Strong Openweight Tag Team Champion, 2008 G1 Climax, 2009, 2010 and 2012 New Japan Cup, 2012, 2014, 2021, 2022 and 2023 World Tag League, 2005 Young Lion Cup, 2010 and 2011 J Sports Crown Openweight 6 Man Tag Tournament, 2005 Samurai!

TV Openweight Tag Tournament, 2005 Jr. Heavyweight Tag MVP Award, 1 time NWA International Junior Heavyweight Championship and 2007 Yamaha Cup. Category:Actors Category:Male Actors Category:Real-life people Category:Wrestlers Category:Grapplers
